design.name: 磐 (giant pangolin craftsman warrior monk)
design.role: 坦克：裂地重击（大尾砸地）/ 磐石壁垒（鳞甲张开）/ 厚皮
design.brief: A big, round, huggable anthropomorphic Chinese PANGOLIN (穿山甲) craftsman warrior monk, the tank of the team, drawn in exactly the same cute-heroic chibi-leaning style as the reference heroes: a BIG head (about a quarter of the body height) with large expressive amber eyes with bright highlights, thick friendly brows, a short rounded snout and a confident cheeky grin; a barrel-shaped body much wider than the other heroes, short thick arms and legs, oversized hands and boots. Natural armour: a FEW big, simple, chunky overlapping scales (large carved plates, not dozens of small ones) cover the top of the head like a helmet crest, the back, the outer forearms and the long broad tail, warm bronze-olive with clean gold edges; only a thin line of amber spirit fire glows in a few seams. Pale cream face and belly. Fully clothed, no bare chest: a padded saffron-orange monk jacket with a high crossed collar, a deep teal sash, a short leather craftsman apron with a chisel and a small brass plumb bob, baggy dark trousers wrapped at the shins, chunky straw-and-leather boots. Big hands with FIVE digits each: a clearly separate opposable thumb on the inner side plus four separate thick fingers, five short blunt claws per hand.
design.weapon: a chunky bronze drill-cannon shotgun resting on his shoulder in one hand, the other fist punching the ground with a small burst of amber cracks and pebbles
design.turnaround_lead: Neutral standing A-pose for rigging: arms held about 40 degrees away from the body with straight elbows, both hands open, flat and EMPTY (no gun, no grenade, no weapons anywhere), legs straight and slightly apart, mouth closed, calm expression
design.turnaround_pose: , the back scales lying flat and closed with the amber seams glowing softly (no sparks or effects), the long broad scaled tail extending straight backwards and slightly down behind the body with its tip just above the ground, fully shown in the side views
design.turnaround_digits: each hand open with a separate thumb and four separate slightly spread thick fingers ending in short blunt claws, both sandal boots complete.
design.style_note: The hand close-up must show the palm with the thumb sticking out to the side, clearly apart from the four fingers: count five claws.
